definitions.explanation: Describes something related to public institutions, government, or official capacity, as opposed to private or personal matters.

examples.japanese: {公的|こうてき}な{機関|きかん}に{相談|そうだん}した。
{公的|こうてき}な{文書|ぶんしょ}には{署名|しょめい}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A signature is required on official documents.

examples.japanese: {公的|こうてき}な{支援|しえん}を{受|う}けるには{申請|しんせい}が{必要|ひつよう}になります。
examples.english: An application is required to receive public assistance.

notes:
Describes matters relating to the public sphere, government, or official institutions. Forms a natural pair with {私的|してき}な (private, personal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公的|こうてき}な{機関|きかん}: public institution
- {公的|こうてき}な{支援|しえん}: public assistance
- {公的|こうてき}な{資金|しきん}: public funds
- {公的|こうてき}な{文書|ぶんしょ}: official document
- {公的|こうてき}な{立場|たちば}: official position

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {公|おおやけ}の: public, official — native Japanese word, slightly less formal
- {公式|こうしき}な: formal, official — emphasizes being formally recognized or sanctioned
- {国|くに}の: national, governmental — more specific to national government
- {公的|こうてき}な ↔ {私的|してき}な: public vs. private
